basics.name: Vandit Patel
basics.label: PhD Student, Indian Institute of Science
basics.summary: PhD student at the Representation Learning Lab, IISc, working on the theory of generative models and sequential decision making. Previously ML Engineer at Stryker AI Research.

courses: Advanced Deep Representation Learning (Deep Generative Models)

education.area: Electrical Engineering, Minor in Computer Engineering

work.name: Stryker, AI Research
work.summary: Applied research on adapting large models to specialised domains under data constraints.
highlights: Studied parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large language models for domain adaptation, analysing the trade-off between low-rank constraints, expressive power, and generalisation error.
Investigated retrieval-generation coupling in agentic pipelines, connecting retrieval quality and error propagation to bias-variance and sample-efficiency arguments.
Built a resume-matching framework and analysed the stability of learning-to-rank under distribution shift.
Designed generative pipelines for low-data regimes, studying mode coverage and divergence minimisation.

work.name: Stryker
highlights: Configured the control console and reframed a small-object detection problem (2-5 mm diameter) as a classification task.

projects.name: Survival Analysis and Optimal Timed Interventions
projects.description: Master's research at IISc under Prof. Chiranjib Bhattacharyya on deciding when to intervene before a critical event.
highlights: Established the equivalence of the optimally timed intervention problem with an optimal stopping problem on a hazard rate process, yielding principled intervention policies.
Developed a DDRSA architecture with ProbSparse attention to model hazard rate functions over long monitoring histories.
Applications to predictive maintenance, medical emergency response, and security breach prevention.

projects.name: Community Detection in Real Networks
projects.description: Implemented and compared Karger's min-cut, Girvan-Newman, and Louvain community detection on Facebook social graphs and Bitcoin transaction networks, evaluating modularity against computational cost.

projects.name: Duckworth-Lewis Method for Cricket
projects.description: Non-linear regression implementation of the Duckworth-Lewis target revision method, validated against the traditional formula through probabilistic match simulation.

projects.name: Modelling of Faults in Induction Machines
projects.description: Undergraduate project: built a mathematical model of induction machine faults and developed a frequency-response-based mechanism for fault prediction.
